acceptance: Converter unit tests per construct, plus golden-file tests on 5 real pages including a former-RST hub page
Full docs/ converts with zero unknown-construct errors
All internal links and anchors resolve (site_inventory diff: zero broken internal links, zero lost fragment ids)
MDX used only where a component is present (counted in build output)
No committed generated content; docs/ unchanged by the build
description:
Write a converter that runs inside site-build and reads docs/**/*.md as the canonical source (guardrail G-b). It writes Astro content-collection entries to a gitignored build directory.

Output format: plain Markdown by default. MDX is emitted only for a page that needs a component (callout, mermaid, embed), so authoring and parsing constraints stay minimal.

Constructs to handle, with counts re-measured after astro-site-30:
- {tags} (219) → frontmatter tags and tag pages
- toctrees (16 MyST + those converted from 39 RST) → sidebar config and section order
- admonitions (26) → Callout
- {doc}/{ref} and converted :doc: roles (236 before astro-site-30) → resolved relative links
- {mermaid} (6) → build-time SVG
- labels and explicit anchors kept as the same fragment ids; tables, images, Cobalt2-equivalent code highlighting

Any directive, role or syntax it does not know is a hard build error naming file and line. Output is idempotent: a byte-identical rebuild from the same input.
